component.name: LinuxViewer
component.summary: Điều khiển máy tính từ xa tương thích UltraViewer

description.p: Control another computer with its UltraViewer ID and password, or share this Linux computer. Screen, keyboard and mouse, computer audio, chat, clipboard, screenshots and recording.
LinuxViewer is an independent implementation and is not an official UltraViewer product.
